defects.expected: Missing/invalid provider claims cannot use registered-only legacy grants
defects.actual: Complete valid global-word create succeeded with missing claim
defects.cause: isRegisteredUser treated missing firebase/provider as registered
defects.fix: Require explicit map, nonempty string provider, nonanonymous identity; field guest sync unchanged

defects.expected: Clients cannot grant legacy scores or purchases
defects.actual: Profile score update, state score create, exact-price atomic purchase succeeded
defects.cause: Bounded client score fields and atomic debit were mistaken for trusted earning authority
defects.fix: Profile-only affected keys; wallpaper-only state mutations; client purchases denied. Preserve trusted score fields on profile edits.

defects.expected: Cancelled export leaves no new destination payload and preserves overwritten file
defects.actual: Previous store checked cancellation after publishing but cleaned only temporary file; Android had no discard channel
defects.cause: Destination lifecycle not included in cancellation cleanup
defects.fix: Unique staging, destination serialization and backup restore; Android tracks new export URI and requires discard acknowledgement; cleanupFailed UI cannot claim cancelled

defects.expected: Rollback failure preserves original bytes for recovery
defects.actual: Initial new store deleted backup in finally after rollback failed
defects.fix: Retain previous backup on rollback failure while deleting new export payload; explicit cleanup failure

defects.expected: Native Kotlin change can be compiled within bounded verifier without full Android packaging
defects.fix: AndroidCompileOnly Targeted/Integration; reject mixed/subsystem/release selectors; gradle launcher/local properties included in environment fingerprint

defects.expected: Selected preview can be compiled with exact safe flags through bounded verifier
defects.actual: Existing verifier had no profile selector; build flags existed only in B01 specification
defects.fix: LocalLearningPreview selector and canonical two-flag profile; reject mixed/release use and modified flag profile. Compiled test confirms production factory binding.

defects.actual: Legacy closure excludes tool paths outside tool/cli
defects.baseline: G7.5-helper-baseline.json confirms source unchanged since G7.4; no actual previous test behavior failure
defects.fix: Conservatively include all tool/ inputs and recheck affected architecture tests; retain original receipts

diagnostics.detail: First claim test lacked required word fields and passed for the wrong reason. Replaced with complete valid payload before second red run, which demonstrated missing-claim bypass. No acceptance reduction.

Initial scoped reads included absent functions, test/security/package.json and test/cli paths. Switched to rg file inventory and actual root package.json/tool/cli/tests; functions exist only in frozen main donor. No user files modified or removed.

@firebase/util createMockUserToken inserts firebase.sign_in_provider=custom for empty options. First post-fix run179/180 exposed this test issue, not a rule bypass. Explicit firebase:undefined omits the JWT claim; final180/180 passed. Empty map, empty/nonstring/anonymous provider also denied.

Initial export regression compile also exposed misplaced dart:io import from patch insertion. Moved import to directives before implementation verification; missing API errors and later real rollback failure retained.
Initial diff --check treats preserved CRLF as whitespace. Subsequent cr-at-eol source diff check passed; raw logs force-added as binary with B16 attributes. No test was skipped.
